object.attr: stakeholder: in the GUI a reviewer finds the change by hand in the target's History tab, while the MCP server already says what changed. Fields named, so that outgoing links aren't counted (MELLON-TRACE-SRS-62; requirements review Q18).
object.description: When the user selects a suspect outgoing link in the Inspector, the Document Editor should show which of the target's description, attributes, table and figure differ between the acknowledged commit and the last change.
